item.title: PayPal And KKR Sign New Agreement For Up To €65 Billion In European Buy Now Pay Later Receivables
item.description: PayPal and KKR have expanded their partnership through a new agreement that will enable KKR’s credit funds and accounts to purchase up to €65 billion of PayPal’s current and future European buy-now-pay-later receivables through March 2028. The renewed arrangement includes a loan commitment of up to €6 billion and covers BNPL loans originated in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom.
